statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Extreme macro stress persists, but fresh independently verified one-way NQ structure is unavailable, so Tail remains below the blocking threshold.
recommendation: Current public policy mapping is WATCH; any higher Tail state remains contingent on verified persistent directional efficiency, failed retracements or similarly strong price-path evidence.
headline: Extreme oil and rates stress persists while overnight Tail remains WATCH
body: U.S. equities closed lower as Treasury yields approached 5% and Brent settled at $107.63. Oracle reported stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue and rose about 7% after hours, adding a countervailing technology catalyst. Fresh exact overnight NQ structure is not independently verified; CPI at 12:30 UTC is the next major checkpoint.

outlookSummary: Overnight Tail can ease if price discovery stays two-sided, but oil, yields and geopolitical disruption keep Stress extreme. CPI at 12:30 UTC, the 13:30 UTC cash open and Michigan data at 14:00 UTC form the next concentrated risk window; higher Tail requires observed persistence or similarly strong path evidence.
